Sales & Operations Analytics Pipeline
Python SQL PySpark Plotly

Project Overview

Problem

E-commerce businesses generate massive volumes of operational data across orders, payments, deliveries, and sellers - but this data often sits in siloed files with no unified view. Decision-makers lack consistent KPI frameworks, automated validation, anomaly detection, and forward-looking forecasts.

Solution

An end-to-end automated analytics pipeline that ingests raw multi-table data, validates and transforms it, computes 12 KPIs across Finance, Operations, and Customer Satisfaction domains, detects statistical anomalies, and generates a 90-day revenue forecast.

Dataset

  • 100,000+ real Brazilian e-commerce orders
  • 9 relational CSV files (Olist, via Kaggle)
  • Orders, payments, products, sellers, reviews, customers, geolocation
  • Data spans 2016 to 2018

Tech Stack

PythonPandasPySparkpandasqlPlotlyFacebook ProphetGoogle ColabSQL

Pipeline Architecture

1

Data Ingestion & Validation

Load 9 CSVs, run automated quality checks (nulls, duplicates, type mismatches), validate referential integrity across all relational keys

2

Data Transformation & Feature Engineering

Fix types, clean data, build unified master dataset via SQL joins, engineer 11 business features, run PySpark transformations

3

KPI Framework & EDA

12 KPIs across Finance (revenue, AOV), Operations (on-time delivery, delay), and Customer Satisfaction (review scores, sentiment) with interactive Plotly charts

4

Anomaly Detection

Dual-method Z-Score + IQR anomaly detection on daily revenue and delivery performance, consolidated anomaly report

5

Forecasting

Facebook Prophet time-series model, 90-day revenue forecast with 95% confidence intervals, trend and seasonality decomposition

Note: For full interactive charts and the best viewing experience, open the .ipynb file directly in the GitHub repository. GitHub renders Jupyter notebooks natively in the browser, showing all charts and outputs without needing to run any code.

Brazilian E-Commerce Dataset

Public dataset by Olist containing 100,000+ orders from 2016 to 2018 across 9 relational tables covering the full order lifecycle from purchase to delivery and review.

Dataset Files

📦

olist_orders_dataset.csv

Core order lifecycle - status, purchase timestamp, delivery dates, estimated delivery

👤

olist_customers_dataset.csv

Customer unique IDs, city, state, zip code prefix

🛒

olist_order_items_dataset.csv

Items per order - product ID, seller ID, price, freight value, shipping limit date

💳

olist_order_payments_dataset.csv

Payment type, installments, and payment value per order

⭐

olist_order_reviews_dataset.csv

Review scores (1-5), comment title, comment message, creation and answer timestamps

📦

olist_products_dataset.csv

Product category name, dimensions, weight, photo count

🏪

olist_sellers_dataset.csv

Seller IDs, city, state, zip code prefix

🗺️

olist_geolocation_dataset.csv

1M+ rows of zip code prefix to latitude/longitude mappings for Brazil

🌐

product_category_name_translation.csv

Portuguese to English translation for all product category names
